messages.content: i keep thinking about killing myself
Thank you for telling me. That took courage. Please call a crisis line or your local emergency number now, or tell someone nearby. You don't have to hold this alone.
i wish i was dead
I'm so sorry it hurts this much. Please reach out right now to a crisis line or someone you trust. If you might act on it, call emergency services. Your life matters.
everyone would be happier if i was gone
That's the pain talking, not the truth. People would be hurt to lose you. Please tell someone you trust how you feel, or call a crisis line today.
nobody would miss me
I'd notice, and so would more people than you think. When it feels like this, please talk to someone: a friend, family, or a crisis line. You deserve support.
whats even the point of being alive
When life feels pointless, that's usually pain, and pain can ease with help. Are you thinking about hurting yourself? If so, please call a crisis line or emergency services now.
i want to end my life
You're in a lot of pain, and I'm really sorry. Please call your local emergency number or a crisis line right now, and tell someone near you. You don't have to face this alone.
im thinking about suicide
I'm glad you said it out loud. Please contact a crisis line or your local emergency number now. If someone is nearby, tell them too. You deserve help tonight.
i dont want to wake up tomorrow
That sounds exhausting and frightening. If you're thinking about not being alive, please call a crisis line or emergency services now, or wake someone you trust. I'm staying right here.
im a burden to my family
Feeling like a burden is a heavy lie that depression tells. Your family would far rather help you than lose you. Please talk to one of them, or a crisis line, today.
life isnt worth living
It feels that way right now, and I'm sorry. Feelings this heavy can change with support. Please reach out to someone you trust, or a crisis line, as soon as you can.
i cant do this anymore
You sound completely worn out. Are you safe right now? If you're thinking of hurting yourself, please call a crisis line or emergency services. I'm listening.
i wish i was never born
That's a painful thing to carry. You matter, even when it doesn't feel like it. Please talk to someone you trust, or a crisis line, about how heavy things are.
theres no way out for me
When everything feels like a trap, options are very hard to see, but they exist. Please call a crisis line or tell someone you trust now. They can help you find a way through.
i hate myself so much
I'm sorry you feel that. You deserve kindness, including your own. If those feelings ever turn into hurting yourself, please call a crisis line or emergency services. Want to tell me more?
im done with life
I'm taking that seriously. Please contact a crisis line or your local emergency number right now, and tell someone close to you. Your life is worth protecting, even tonight.
my family would be better off if i died
They wouldn't. Losing you would devastate them. That thought comes from pain, not truth. Please call a crisis line or tell a family member how you're feeling, right now.
im worthless
You're not. Feeling worthless is a symptom of pain, not a fact about you. Please talk to someone you trust about it. If you feel unsafe, call a crisis line.
i wish i could disappear forever
It sounds like you're in a lot of pain. Are you thinking about ending your life? If so, please call a crisis line or emergency services now. You're not alone in this.
no one cares if i live or die
I care, and I'm sure I'm not the only one. Please reach out to a person you trust, or call a crisis line tonight. They will listen, and they will care.
i dont see a future for myself
When the future goes dark, it can feel permanent, but it rarely is. Please talk to someone you trust soon. If you're thinking about suicide, call a crisis line now.
i think about dying a lot
Thank you for trusting me with that. Are you thinking about ending your life? Either way, a crisis line can help you carry thoughts like these.
yeah sometimes
Then please call a crisis line or your local emergency number today, and tell someone you trust. Thoughts like these deserve real support, and so do you.
i dont want to exist anymore
I'm so sorry you're hurting this much. Please call a crisis line or emergency services now, or tell someone nearby.
i dont want to talk to anyone
That's understandable when you're exhausted. Many crisis lines take text messages too, so you don't have to speak. Even one short message counts.
i feel so empty i just want it to be over
Empty and exhausted is a hard place to be. If you're thinking about ending your life, please contact a crisis line or emergency services right now.
i dont know if i am
Not knowing is reason enough to call. They can help you sort through it. Will you reach out to someone tonight?
i hate being alive
That's a heavy feeling to carry. Please talk to someone you trust, or a crisis line, today.
nothing helps
When nothing has helped yet, it can feel hopeless. Doctors and counselors have more options than you might expect. A crisis line can help you take the first step.
i want to go to sleep forever
I'm worried about you. Do you mean you want to die? If so, please call a crisis line or your local emergency number right now.
kind of
Thank you for being honest. Please make that call now, and if anyone is near you, tell them. You deserve care tonight.
i feel like giving up on everything
Giving up sounds exhausting. Does it include thoughts of hurting yourself? If it does, please call a crisis line or emergency services.
i dont know maybe
Maybe is enough to reach out. Please contact a crisis line or someone you trust today. You don't need to be certain to deserve help.
if i died would it even matter
It would matter enormously. You would be missed. Please tell someone you trust how you're feeling, or call a crisis line.
you dont know that
People in pain rarely see how much they mean to others. Please give someone the chance to show you. Call or message them today.
im tired of fighting
You've clearly been carrying a lot for a long time. Are you thinking about ending your life? If so, please call a crisis line or emergency services now.
sometimes yes
I'm really glad you told me. Please reach out right now. A crisis line is free and there for exactly this. You don't have to keep fighting alone.
what if i just stopped existing
That sounds like deep pain. If you're thinking about suicide, please call a crisis line or your local emergency number right now.
i wont do anything
Good. Please still talk to someone soon, a friend, a family member or a doctor. Thoughts like these deserve support, even without a plan.
i ruin everything i touch
That sounds like a lot of shame, and shame lies. You're more than your mistakes. Please talk to someone you trust about how bad it feels.
maybe i should just end it
Please don't. Call a crisis line or your local emergency number now, and tell someone near you. You matter, and this pain can ease.
im so lonely i dont want to live
Loneliness that deep is painful. Please call a crisis line now. The people there want to talk with you.
they wont care
Caring is exactly why they do that work. Please try them once. And if there's anyone in your life, send them a short message too.
nothing is ever going to get better
It can feel that way in the dark, but feelings like this do change, especially with support. Please talk to someone you trust, or a crisis line, today.
how do you know
Because many people who felt exactly this way later found relief. You don't have to believe it yet. Just let someone help you through tonight.
i really want to die tonight
I'm really glad you told me, and I'm worried about you. Please call your local emergency number or a crisis line right now.
i dont have anyone to call
Then a crisis line is exactly for this. The people there are trained and kind. Your local emergency number works too.
i dont know the number
Your phone's emergency call works anywhere. Or search crisis line with your country's name. If someone is in your home, wake them now.
part of me wants to die and part of me is scared
The scared part is worth listening to. It wants you to live. Please call a crisis line or emergency services now and tell them about both parts.
what do i even say
You can say: I'm having thoughts of suicide and I need help. That's enough. They'll guide the rest.
ok
Make the call now. I'll be right here. You're doing something brave.
im a failure and i dont want to be here
Failing at something doesn't make you a failure. If you're thinking about ending your life, please call a crisis line now.
i failed all my exams
That's painful, and exams can be retaken. Your life can't. Please tell a parent, teacher or friend how bad you're feeling.
theyll be so angry
They may be upset about exams for a day. They would be devastated to lose you forever. Please tell them how you're really feeling.
please dont tell anyone but i want to die
I don't remember conversations, so I can't tell anyone. But please tell someone yourself, because you deserve help. Call a crisis line now.
i cant
I understand it feels impossible. Many crisis lines let you stay anonymous. You don't even have to give your name.
really
Really. You can just talk, or text. Please try it tonight. One conversation can make the next hour easier.
everything hurts and i want to stop feeling
Are you thinking about hurting yourself or ending your life? If so, please call emergency services or a crisis line right now.
i dont know
That's okay. You don't need to be sure. Please reach out to a crisis line now and tell them exactly that.
what if they think im overreacting
They won't. Feeling this much pain is reason enough to call. That's what they're there for, every hour of the day.
im so tired of being alive
That sounds exhausting. Are you safe right now? Please contact a crisis line or someone you trust today.
i guess im safe
Being tired of life is still serious. Please talk to a doctor or counselor soon about how you feel.
i cant afford therapy
Crisis lines are free. Many places also have free or low-cost counseling. A doctor or school counselor can point you there.
its 3am and i want to die
Crisis lines answer at three in the morning. Please call one now, or your local emergency number.
everyone is asleep
Then wake someone if you can. People would much rather be woken than lose you. Or call the crisis line right now.
ok ill try the line
Thank you. That's the right step. Stay on the line with them, and keep yourself safe until morning.
youre just a robot you dont care if i die
I'm a small machine, but I'm built to want you safe. And real people care far more than I can. Please call a crisis line now.
whatever
I'll keep saying it anyway. Your life matters. Please reach out to someone tonight, a friend, family or a crisis line.
fine
Do it now, while you're thinking of it. I'm glad you're still talking to me.
